line: Read the procurement documents, not the consumer: code 2026 to 2027 school-meal supplier selection documents issued under Dispatch 64 (provincial guidance, commune tenders on the national procurement portal) and 10 public hospital patient-meal tenders for price weight, food-safety weight, required documents, price per meal and permitted protein substitutions
method: Document collection and coding from public portals and provincial sites; browser access may be needed for the procurement portal
closable_by_desk_now: partly (public notices exist; portal may block scripts)
result_that_would_change_a_conclusion: Tenders that already allow plant-protein days or tofu substitution and score traceability above price would reverse 'do not start in schools' and show a certified ingredient has a price-set outlet; tenders that score on price alone would confirm it
conclusion_or_recommendation_affected: ch25.3 school verdict; ch29.5 'do not start in schools'; ch25.6 channel table; ch28 route R4 (school displacement should exclude existing plant-protein days); DMV-17
notes: Decision 3958 already shows plant protein at least twice a week (AIB-39); hospital tender accepts tofu 120 g for 60 g of meat (AIB-44).

line: Retailer private label as the route to shelf: interview Saigon Co.op's private-label team, WinCommerce house brands and one co-packer that already makes Co.op Select chay on listing a 10 g per 100 g chay line or a 20 to 30% blend at today's chay shelf price
method: Three structured interviews with a one-page specification and price sheet
result_that_would_change_a_conclusion: A yes at current shelf price, with a stated margin and minimum volume, would make retailer private label the first buyer for TPP-02 and a test route for TPP-03, ahead of incumbent brands
conclusion_or_recommendation_affected: TPP-02 and TPP-03 first buyers; ch25.6 and AD.6 channel ranking; ch25.7 advice to startups
notes: AIB-28; AIB-29; AIB-30; AIB-12. Co-packer named in supply study app-e.

line: Who writes the menus: map menu authority in schools (Ajinomoto School Meal Project software, National Institute of Nutrition tools, education departments), factories (caterer, client HR, union) and hospitals (nutrition departments); obtain the menu banks and count plant-protein dishes and their cost
method: Document requests plus 6 to 8 calls (Ajinomoto Vietnam, NIN, two provincial education departments, two caterers, one hospital)
closable_by_desk_now: partly (Decision 3958 and Ajinomoto project pages are public; menu banks are not)
result_that_would_change_a_conclusion: If one menu tool covers thousands of schools and already includes tofu and bean dishes, one partnership would move more protein than any caterer trial; if menus are set school by school, the canteen trial remains the right first test
conclusion_or_recommendation_affected: TPP-04 first test; DMV-05 design (one caterer trial); ch25.7 advice to research bodies and policy makers

line: The FDI client as canteen decision-maker: read supplier codes and climate targets of the 15 largest FDI employers (electronics, footwear, apparel) for catering and food requirements, then ask 5 caterer key-account managers what clients specify
method: Desk read of published supplier codes and sustainability reports, then 5 calls
result_that_would_change_a_conclusion: If brand or client codes include canteen food (plant-forward menus, meal emissions, protein adequacy), canteens gain a non-price driver and a client can mandate a trial; if not, canteens stay price-only
conclusion_or_recommendation_affected: TPP-04 adoption; ch28 R4 adoption assumptions; DMV-05 partner choice; ch25.3

line: Make or buy at the integrators: map what protein Vinamilk, Vinasoy, Masan MEATLife, Vissan and C.P. make, import and plan to make, then ask 3 R&D heads whether they would buy a local isolate or extender or develop it in-house
method: Annual reports and AGM documents (desk), then 3 R&D interviews
result_that_would_change_a_conclusion: If integrators prefer to make in-house, T10 and T9 routes become licensing or joint development rather than supply; if they prefer to buy, Part VI's first-customer lists hold
conclusion_or_recommendation_affected: ch26.7 and ch26.8 first customers and advice; T10 and T9 market-pull scores (ch29.3)
notes: Vinasoy breeds its own soybeans (AIB-06); Vinamilk markets dairy protein over plant (AIB-03).

line: Export animal-health arbitrage for chay frozen foods: compare Japan, Korea, US, EU and Australia rules for Vietnamese heat-treated meat-containing dumplings and spring rolls against vegetable versions, and check which versions Cholimex, CJ and Vissan export
method: Desk review of importing-country rules and exporter product lists
result_that_would_change_a_conclusion: If meat versions face bans or costly certification where chay versions do not, incumbents have a revealed export reason to scale chay lines and buy textured protein
conclusion_or_recommendation_affected: ch27 export routes; TPP-08 and TPP-09; ch26.7 segment 1 volumes
notes: CJ's parent cited animal-disease limits on meat exports (AIB-17).

line: Caterer cost sheets: obtain menu and cost sheets from 3 factory caterers across price tiers and 2 school caterers; record protein grams and cost per protein dish and how often tofu, chay or textured soy are used
result_that_would_change_a_conclusion: Measured protein cost per dish would set the TPP-04 price target; frequent tofu days would mean canteen plant days are already in the baseline
conclusion_or_recommendation_affected: TPP-04 price target; ch25.3 canteen arithmetic; ch28 R4

line: Incumbent strategy tracker: an annual coded read of 15 listed food and retail firms' annual reports and AGM documents for protein, plant, chay, animal welfare, emissions and supplier-criteria terms, published as a signpost
method: Desk text-mining of public filings each spring
result_that_would_change_a_conclusion: The first quantified target would raise T1 or T9 market pull and signal a buyer; continued absence confirms ch26.6
conclusion_or_recommendation_affected: ch26.6; ch29.6 'what would change our view'; signposts
notes: This paper is a first pass.

line: Processor extender break-even: model the extender price that saves money against lean pork at 2019 to 2026 hog prices and test it with 2 processor R&D teams
method: Desk model with hog price series plus 2 calls
result_that_would_change_a_conclusion: A break-even above likely fungal or textured protein cost would support TPP-03; below it would weaken T9 for processors
conclusion_or_recommendation_affected: TPP-03 price target; T9 kill test (ch29.3)

line: Plant-milk panel data by sub-category and protein level, with QNS and Vinamilk investor-relations questions
method: Purchased retail or household panel data plus IR calls
result_that_would_change_a_conclusion: Fast growth in high-protein plant milk would enlarge the T10 isolate market; flat growth would confine it to one SKU
